spans.s: त्रेता f. 1. A triad, a triplet; 2. the three sacred fires collectively, (See अग्नित्रेता), R.xiii.37; 3. a particular throw at dice, a cast of three at dice, त्रेताहृतसर्वस्वः Mrich.ii.; 4. the second of the four yugas of the Hindus. See युग.
त्रेधा ind. Triply, in three ways, नमः … … तुभ्यं त्रेधा स्थितात्मने R.x.16.
